title: AiPrise Partners With Range to Bring Business Verification and Transaction Controls Into One Line of Sight
summary: Compliance teams running stablecoins and fiat can now verify who they are dealing with and screen what moves, through two platforms built to work together.
body_markdown:
Today AiPrise is announcing a partnership with[Range](https://range.org/) , the platform for companies operating across stablecoins and fiat. The two platforms already share customers who run them side by side. From today, AiPrise customers who need onchain controls, and Range customers who need KYB and KYC across markets, get a direct introduction to the other team.


## Two Questions, Two Layers


Every compliance team moving money across stablecoins and fiat answers two questions on every customer.


The first is who. Is this business real, who owns it, is anyone behind it sanctioned or politically exposed, and has any of that changed since onboarding. That is KYB, KYC and ongoing monitoring. It is AiPrise's job.


The second is what. Is this wallet clean, is this transaction safe to execute, does this flow hit a sanctions list or a known fraud pattern before the capital moves. That is transaction screening and treasury control across stablecoins and fiat. It is Range's job.


Most teams buy those layers separately and work out the handoff themselves. This partnership is built around that handoff.


## What This Means for a Compliance Team


**Onboarding and transaction risk stay in one line of sight.** A business verified through AiPrise can have its wallets and flows screened through Range, and a change on either side, a new UBO, a flagged counterparty, a wallet that turns up on a list, is a signal rather than a surprise.


**There is one less vendor search.** Teams on either platform get a referral and a working introduction to the other, not a cold evaluation.


**Each layer keeps its own audit trail.** AiPrise records why an entity was approved. Range records why a transaction was allowed to execute. Together, a team can show an examiner how both decisions were made.


## Next


If you run AiPrise and want[Range](https://range.org/) in front of your treasury and payment flows, tell your AiPrise contact. We will make the introduction. If you are coming from Range and need KYB and KYC that works in the markets you are entering,[talk to us](https://www.aiprise.com/schedule-your-demo) .
